name: TAIWAN SEMICONDUCTOR MANUFACTURING CO LTD
description:
## Business Overview
Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (**TSMC**) is a pure‑play semiconductor **foundry** that manufactures **logic** and related chips for **fabless** and integrated-device customers on a contract basis, monetizing primarily through **wafer sales** priced by process node/technology options and volume commitments. It also provides **advanced packaging** and related manufacturing services (e.g., chip integration/assembly flows) that are often sold alongside wafer production.

## Market Position
TSMC is widely regarded as the leading advanced-node foundry, with scale advantages in leading-edge manufacturing, yield/quality, and ecosystem enablement; it also reports a **34%** market share of its defined **“Foundry 2.0”** industry. Differentiators include deep process/R&D execution, high-volume leading-edge capacity, and integrated offerings spanning manufacturing and advanced packaging.

## Key Segments
TSMC reports end-market platforms including **HPC**, **Smartphone**, **IoT**, **Automotive**, and **DCE/Other**; in **2024** it reported net revenue mix of **51% HPC** and **35% Smartphone** (with remaining revenue across IoT, Automotive, DCE, and other categories).
